settlements.arrival.title: {settlement}
settlements.arrival.hint.enter: Walk in as guests: the hall, the market, the mead-hall.
settlements.arrival.hint.parley: Meet the leader at the shore and hear the news.
settlements.arrival.hint.raid: Strike the outskirts, seize what you can carry and get back to the ships.
settlements.arrival.hint.assault: Storm the place and decide its fate.
settlements.arrival.hint.besiege: Ring the walls and starve them out.
settlements.reason.atWar: You are at war with its lord.
settlements.reason.noMen: You have no men to fight with.
settlements.reason.noWalls: There are no walls to besiege.
settlements.reason.siegeLater: Siege craft is not yet ready.
settlements.reason.noGovernor: No one with you can hold it.
settlements.reason.tooFewToHold: Too few men to hold it.
settlements.reason.noAlly: No rightful lord to give it back to.
settlements.reason.noNotables: No one here worth carrying off.
settlements.fate.title: {settlement} has fallen
settlements.fate.hint.sackAndBurn: Take everything and leave ashes. Feared for years.
settlements.fate.hint.spare: Take a gift of silver and leave the people be.
settlements.fate.hint.takeCaptives: Carry off the leader for ransom.
settlements.fate.hint.makeTributary: A lump of silver now and tribute each year.
settlements.fate.hint.annex: Leave a governor and a garrison. It becomes your holding.
settlements.notify.parley: {leader} of {settlement} meets you at the shore.
settlements.notify.fate.liberate: {settlement} is given back to its lord.
settlements.cargo.title: Cargo
settlements.tavern.title: Mead-hall
settlements.tavern.buyRound: Buy a round for the hall
settlements.error.noArrival: There is nothing to decide here.
settlements.error.noAftermath: There is no fallen settlement to decide on.
settlements.error.noLoot: There is nothing left to plunder.
settlements.error.notInside: You are not in the settlement.
settlements.ui.hall.purpose: Where the house drinks and listens: hear the news, learn about other places from travellers, raise the hall's spirits and hire sellswords.
settlements.ui.hall.hint.anyNews: Ask the keeper what word has reached this hall.
settlements.ui.hall.hint.travellers: Listen to travellers from nearby ports: what they say of their homes goes into Other places.
settlements.ui.hall.hint.drink: A cup of mead by the fire, and now and then an overheard rumour.
settlements.ui.hall.hint.buyRound: Fill every cup in the hall. Raises your Renown, and the loyalty of a hall of your own.
settlements.ui.hall.result.news: {count, plural, =0 {The keeper has nothing you have not heard already.} one {The keeper tells you one thing you had not heard.} other {The keeper tells you # things you had not heard.}}
settlements.ui.hall.result.travellers: {count, plural, =0 {The travellers have nothing worth hearing tonight.} other {Travellers talk of {places}. See Other places.}}
settlements.ui.hall.result.drink: You drink by the fire. ({silver} silver)
settlements.ui.hall.result.round: The hall roars its thanks. {renown, plural, =0 {} other {Renown +#.}} {loyalty, select, yes {Your people's loyalty rises.} other {}} ({silver} silver)
settlements.ui.sellswords.title: Sellswords
settlements.ui.sellswords.none: No sellswords drink in this mead-hall this month.
settlements.ui.sellswords.capacity: Lieutenants: {used} of {capacity}. A larger hall keeps more.
settlements.ui.hall.result.drinkHeard: You drink by the fire ({silver} silver).{heard, plural, =0 {} other { At the next bench someone is talking, and you overhear something new.}}
settlements.cue.hamlet: Land! A few roofs by the shore.
settlements.cue.town: Land! A town on the strand.
settlements.cue.city: Land! Roofs as far as the eye goes.
settlements.cue.capital: Land! A royal seat, banners on the hall.
settlements.cue.cloister: Land! A lantern-tower on the headland.
settlements.cue.fortress: Land! Walls, and watchers on them.
settlements.cue.emporium: Land! Masts thick along the strand.
settlements.cue.templeStead: Land! A temple roof above the grove.
settlements.cue.own: Home waters! Our own hall ahead.
settlements.cue.raided: Land! Black timbers, and no songs.
